## HueMux v0.0.4-alpha.9 — Lights-first launch, a smarter brightness slider, and a closeable color picker

> **Alpha.** This release is about the everyday light-control screen: the app
> now opens on Lights instead of Sync, remembers which tab you were on, the
> brightness slider can actually turn lights on and off, the color picker can
> be closed, and a whitespace-trimming fix stops an auth token from silently
> locking you out.

### The app now opens on Lights, and remembers your last tab

The default landing tab is now **Lights** — light control is the day-to-day
screen, Screen Sync the less frequent one. A profile that disabled the Lights
tab falls through to whatever tabs remain.

Because a fresh app launch opens `/app.html` with no tab in the URL, the shell
also remembers the last tab you had open and returns you there. Previously a
WebView relaunch always dropped you back on the same screen, no matter where
you had been working.

### Brightness slider can turn lights on and off

A bare `brightness` command only dims — a physically-off bulb silently stayed
dark while the UI claimed it was on. Dragging a slider now does what the hand
expects:

- dragging **from 0 (or off) to a positive value** turns the light **on**;
- dragging **from a positive value to 0** dims to the floor but stays **on**;
- a repeat **0 → 0** touch is an explicit turn-**off**.

The "previous" value is what you last committed via a slider, falling back to
the live model on first touch, so the turn-off rule survives the bridge
reporting the dimming floor as 1 rather than 0.

### Color picker can be closed

The color picker overlay has a **✕ close button** in its top-left corner. The
whole overlay used to hijack pointer events to pick colors, which made a button
unusable and turned the Android back-swipe (which also starts from the left
edge) into a color pick. The header is now excluded from picking, and the close
label is translated into all 25 supported languages.

### Auth token can no longer silently lock you out

A token with surrounding whitespace passed the old `== ""` check and yet
locked everyone out with a credential invisible to the eye — the classic paste
artifact. Tokens are now trimmed on save, a whitespace-only token is treated as
unset, and the header's lock button only appears when there is actually a
stored token to be asked for again.

### Header buttons line up on mobile

On mobile the navigation leaves the flex row (it becomes a fixed bottom bar),
so the lock/theme/effects buttons now right-align against the edge instead of
sitting directly next to the brand.

### What this does not do

It does not change how lights are controlled on the bridge beyond what is
described here — the new slider behaviour is a different set of commands for
the same on/off/brightness controls, and the room slider still targets the
same grouped-light resource as before.
